hook: Your hotel room in Italy could be a cave.
title: Your Hotel Room in Italy Could Be a Cave
description:
Matera in southern Italy has an old town called the Sassi, carved into the rock. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and some of the caves are now hotels. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Italy #PlacesThatShouldntExist
